response.sql: SELECT f.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time FROM film f WHERE f.length >= 112 GROUP BY f.language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff of 112 minutes is inclusive: 'long films' means length >= 112, not length > 112.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff could be exclusive—only films with length strictly greater than 112 are considered long.
